name: Why Do Kitchen and Bath Permits Get Delayed?

mainEntity.name: What causes the biggest delays in Los Angeles County kitchen and bathroom remodel permits?
mainEntity.text: What causes the biggest delays in Los Angeles County kitchen and bathroom remodel permits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit delays in kitchen and bathroom remodels usually happen because the project is not fully defined before submission. If the plans do not show wall changes, fixture relocations, ventilation, lighting, or structural details clearly, plan check will likely issue corrections. Older homes can be especially challenging because existing conditions often differ from what the original drawings suggest. Coordination problems between the designer, contractor, structural engineer, and specialty consultants can also slow things down. To reduce delays, homeowners should ask for complete permit-ready documents, confirm scope before filing, and avoid making design changes mid-review. A contractor who knows the local process can help sequence the work so plan corrections do not stop the project for weeks at a time.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest permit delays usually come from incomplete drawings, missing structural details, plumbing or electrical revisions, and correction cycles during plan check. Delays can also happen when the project scope changes after submission or when required documents are not coordinated among the designer, contractor, and engineers. Older homes often need more back-and-forth than newer ones.
